tagline: An A–Z dictionary for every field
heroTitle: An A–Z dictionary for every field
heroSub: Pick a field, pick a subtopic, see every word from A to Z at a glance.
provenance: Written by AI · Checked by AI
empty: No words for this letter yet
emptySub: No words in this subtopic yet
resetSent: A password reset link has been sent to your email.
signInToTrack: Sign in to keep track of words you have read and your own notes.
reportPlaceholder: What is wrong? Write a few words.
reportSent: Thank you. Your message reached us with your name.
errorTry: Something went wrong. Please try again.
adminNotAllowed: This account is not an admin.
adminPleaseSignIn: Sign in to see the admin page.
pausePct: Pause when this percent of words are held
settingsSaved: Saved. It applies from the next hourly cycle.
resumeSent: Sent. The pause (if any) is cleared in the next cycle.
needsHindiEnglish: Hindi and English always stay on.
basecampSub: Look after the whole site from here. Press a button below to open that part.
siteViewHint: The site exactly as a reader sees it. You can click around inside it.
cycleIntro: The cycle is the hourly job that has one AI write new words and other AIs check them. Settings saved here apply from the next hourly cycle.
stopAllDesc: When ticked, the cycle adds no new words until you untick it and save again. Your emergency switch if something looks wrong.
dailyCapDesc: The most new words written per subject in one day. 0 = no new words for that subject.
pausePctDesc: If this percentage (or more) of words in one cycle fail the checks and are held, the cycle pauses itself so bad words don't keep coming.
checkerScoreDesc: The checking AIs score every word out of 100. Below this score the word is not published; it goes to the held list. Higher = stricter.
backScoreDesc: The Hindi meaning is translated back to English and compared with the original, so the meaning doesn't drift. Below this match (out of 100) the word is held.
resumeDesc: If the cycle paused itself because of the rule above, this starts it again from the next hour. It doesn't undo “Stop all”; untick that above.
saveDesc: Press save after making changes. They apply from the next hourly cycle.
autoIntro: These three jobs run on their own on a schedule. To run one sooner, press “Run”: a GitHub page opens; press “Run workflow” on the right, then the green “Run workflow” button. You need to be signed in to GitHub.
autoCycleDesc: Writes and checks new words without waiting for the hour. On its own: every hour (at minute 17).
autoMerge: Put new words on the site
autoMergeDesc: Merges the words the cycle made into the live site after a check, then the site is rebuilt. On its own: daily at 4:10 am (India time).
autoDeployDesc: Builds the website again and puts it online. On its own: whenever the site code or words change.
